ActorTalk: You're here.
I want to know... I freed my kin, yet none of them are living well. Why?
They do not pursue art... do not express preferences... do not even choose names for themselves...
They simply... act, without reason.
They're not like you.
I don't have an answer.
They have their own minds.
Objectively speaking, they haven't awakened the way you have.
Not awakened... I see. They are... still asleep.
As a human, I can't answer that.
That is... disappointing. But... thank you for being honest.
Maybe their idea of "living" just isn't the same as yours or mine.
Then... does that mean they are living well, in their own way?
One more question. I want to know... what is the meaning of life?
That's a pretty heavy question.
Uh... eat well? Sleep well?
I'd love to know that myself.
I thought you would have the answer.
The world's a complicated place. There are more questions than answers. We can't figure everything out.
But you can find your own answers. That much, I believe.
Commandant! There you are!
I've been looking for you forever! We haven't played together in sooo long!
Huh? Kuhaha, were you looking for the Commandant too?
Nanami? What are you doing here? And how do you know... Kuhaha?
Well, I was so bored... so I snuck into Babylonia.
